factories.name: new_get_document_text_step
factories.description: Read the first tab of one document, without pending suggestions, as bounded Markdown or plain text with its title and revision ID.

inputSchema.description: GetDocumentTextInput identifies the document whose first tab is read.

documentId.description: DocumentID is the Google Docs document ID, the part of a docs.google.com/document/d/{documentId}/edit link after /d/.

format.description: Format is markdown or plainText; blank renders Markdown.

factories.name: new_create_document_step
factories.description: Create one Google Doc from a title and optional plain-text or Markdown text in an optional Drive folder. Google offers no idempotency key, so the single-dispatch fence requires sync durability to persist its heartbeat across attempts; a private Drive app property supports read-back before any permitted resend.

inputSchema.description: CreateDocumentInput describes one new Google Doc.

initialText.description: InitialText is the document's first content; blank creates an empty document.

initialTextFormat.description: InitialTextFormat is plainText or markdown; blank imports plain text. Markdown asks Drive's Markdown import to create headings, lists, and tables.

parentFolderId.description: ParentFolderID is the destination Drive folder ID; blank creates the document in the My Drive root of the connection's account.

title.description: Title is the new document's title; it must not be blank or contain line breaks.

factories.name: new_replace_document_text_step
factories.description: Replace the whole body text or named text placeholders in the first tab of one document in one batch that Google applies only at the required revision, so a repeated dispatch cannot apply it twice.

PlaceholderReplacement.description: PlaceholderReplacement is one named text placeholder and its replacement.

placeholder.description: Placeholder is the exact, case-sensitive text to replace, such as {{effectiveDate}}. It is 1 to 256 bytes on one line.

text.description: Text replaces every occurrence; blank removes the placeholder. It cannot contain any requested placeholder.

inputSchema.description: ReplaceDocumentTextInput describes one guarded replacement in a document's first tab.

documentId.description: DocumentID is the Google Docs document ID.

placeholders.description: Placeholders lists the placeholders to replace for placeholders, such as {{effectiveDate}}; every one must occur in the body at RequiredRevisionID.

requiredRevisionId.description: RequiredRevisionID is the revision the replacement applies to, normally the RevisionID of a getDocumentText Step. Google applies the change only while the document is still at this revision.

text.description: Text is the new body text for wholeBody; blank empties the body. It is inserted literally, so Markdown markup is not interpreted.

factories.name: new_append_text_step
factories.description: Append plain-text paragraphs to the end of the first tab's body of one document in one batch that Google applies only at the required revision, so a repeated dispatch cannot append twice.

inputSchema.description: AppendTextInput describes text appended to the end of a document's first tab.

documentId.description: DocumentID is the Google Docs document ID.

requiredRevisionId.description: RequiredRevisionID is the revision the text is appended to, normally the RevisionID of a getDocumentText or replaceDocumentText Step. Google appends only while the document is still at this revision.

text.description: Text is appended as one or more plain normal-style paragraphs, one per line, after the body's last paragraph. It must not be blank.
